snippet.title: POPGOES Evergreen BLAKE JUMPSCARE Teaser (for Thankmas 2024)
snippet.description:
Released as a donation incentive for Dawko's charity livestream raising money for Thankmas 2024.
Donate: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVIA47CSIwA

The footage in this clip is gameplay from an alpha (early) build of POPGOES Evergreen.

Everything shown here is subject to change.
